record.original_question: Is there a structural criterion that decides when the tensor product A tensor_F B of two F-division algebras contains a zero divisor, equivalently when it fails to remain a division algebra?

evidence.quote: Problem 9.1. Is there a structural criterion for the tensor product A tensor_F B of two F-division algebras A and B to have a zero divisor?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F$ be a field and let $A$ and $B$ be associative division algebras over $F$ (so $F$ is contained in the center of each). Form the tensor product $A \otimes_F B$ as an $F$-algebra.

Provide a structural criterion, in terms of intrinsic invariants of $A$ and $B$ (such as their centers, maximal subfields, Brauer classes, splitting fields, or other algebraic data), that decides exactly when $A \otimes_F B$ contains a nonzero zero divisor — equivalently, when $A \otimes_F B$ fails to be a division algebra.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of finding a structural criterion for when the tensor product of two F-division algebras has zero divisors remains open in general. While specific cases have been resolved—e.g., Rowen and Saltman constructed examples of finite-dimensional division algebras over a common algebraically closed subfield whose tensor product has zero divisors, refuting one form of the question—a general structural criterion characterizing this phenomenon has not been established. Subsequent work (e.g., on tensor products of division algebras and fields) continues to study related Brauer-group and Picard-group invariants without yielding a complete criterion.

status_evidence.title: Tensor products of division algebras and fields
status_evidence.snippet: Studies when D_1 ⊗_F D_2 is a domain for division algebras D_i with centers containing F; constructs examples where the tensor product has zero divisors.
status_evidence.claim: The general question of when a tensor product of division algebras has zero divisors continues to be studied; explicit counterexamples exist but no general structural criterion is given.

status_evidence.title: Zero divisors in tensor products of division algebras (Bergman)
status_evidence.snippet: Update notes on the problem of zero divisors in tensor products of division algebras.
status_evidence.claim: The problem has been actively revisited but a complete structural criterion remains elusive.

status_evidence.title: Zero divisors in tensor products of division rings
status_evidence.snippet: Early results on when tensor products of division rings acquire zero divisors.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results are known but a full criterion has not been established.
